title: Make templates your own in noctune
tagline: Notes that match how you work.

headline: Two kinds of
template.
scenes.narration: This video covers templates. SOAP note templates shape the clinical record. Discharge templates shape what the client takes home. Open Templates to see your practice's templates, your own, and the ones noctune includes. Switch to the Discharge tab for discharge templates.

headline: Start from the
community.
scenes.narration: Other clinicians share templates in the community library. Filter by type, and open one to preview it. If it suits your practice, choose Add to, then My templates. Open your copy to adjust it and save.

headline: Create your
own.
scenes.narration: To build your own, choose New template, the plus beside search. Copy an existing template, start blank, or import. Name it, choose Create, then edit and save.

headline: Import what
you already use.
scenes.narration: Already have a template in a document? Choose Import, paste it, and choose Organize this. noctune turns it into a draft. If part of it is written for clients, noctune offers to make that a discharge template. Nothing is saved until you choose Save.

headline: Reusable
client emails.
scenes.narration: Email Templates hold client education you send often. Choose a template to preview it. Placeholders, like the patient's name, fill in when you send, and the Placeholder button adds more.

headline: Pick them
on iPhone.
scenes.narration: Templates you set up on the web are ready on iPhone. Choose them before you start recording.
